1 · Intro

When to use it.

Costing goes stale when something about the job or the funding changes. Oracle won't always carry costing forward for you; for example, Oracle notes that costing isn't copied automatically after a global transfer. Learn the events that should send you to check costing.

Use this whenA job, team, or funding change happens to one of your employees.

2 · Walk through

Events that need a costing check.

Check off each item as you read.

Watch-outs

  • Costing follows an employee who changes business units. Review it after every BU transfer so the new area isn't charged to the old accounts.
  • Most of these scenarios don't have walkthroughs recorded yet. Ask your finance partner when unsure.
  • Split funding and cross-unit bonuses may become reference resources rather than core training. To be decided by the HCM group.

HCM Academy job aid · Costing Management

When costing must be updated

Use when: A job, team, or funding change happens to one of your employees. · System: Oracle HCM

  1. How to check costing for any event below.
  2. New hire: is the default OK, or does costing need a program code?
  3. Team change within the work unit: is the program code still correct?
  4. Transfer to another department or business unit: does the old costing still apply?
  5. Bonus, lump sum, or interim pay: should it charge a different COA than salary?
  6. Another work unit pays a bonus for your employee: whose COA, and who enters it?
  7. Split funding (for example, another area pays 20%): split costing setup.
  8. Before every HCM Transaction Cutoff: review costing for your unit.

Watch-outs

  • Costing follows an employee who changes business units. Review it after every BU transfer so the new area isn't charged to the old accounts.
  • Most of these scenarios don't have walkthroughs recorded yet. Ask your finance partner when unsure.
  • Split funding and cross-unit bonuses may become reference resources rather than core training. To be decided by the HCM group.
